about: The Cathedral of Crossings: SigilsVault's Modular Cathedral Kit (walls, columns, vaults, doors, windows with their emission atlas, floors) plus lecterns, pews and candles from Fantasy Props (art brief region 4; decision 0072). The Ruins' gothic arches (region-1/ruins) are reused as they are.

kits.grid: 8 m grid: walls 8 m wide × 16 m tall × 1 m thick with the pivot at a corner (x 0..8, z 0..1), floors 8 × 8 × 1 m (top at y = 0), vault bays 8 m wide and 6–8 m high, columns 23 m (small 9 m). Scale 0.5 lands on the Ruins' 4 m module: a wall 4 × 8 m, a door 2 × 3.4 m (the Ruins' doors are 2.3 × 3 m), a column 11.5 m. One trim sheet for all stone; windows add a diffuse and an emission atlas.

pieces.wall_window_01: wall with a lancet window (stained glass lights from the emission atlas)
pieces.wall_rose_window_01: wall with a rose window (the crossing hall's end wall)
pieces.doorway_01: great doorway (one per town, crossing halls)
pieces.doorway_inner_01: inner doorway between chapel and nave
pieces.door_01: door leaf for the great doorway
pieces.vault_cross_junction_01: crossing vault (centre of a crossing hall)
pieces.floor_03: stone floor, inlaid (the rune-line can run here)
pieces.pedestal_01: plinth for the stone warden or the routing board
pieces.chandelier_01: great hanging chandelier (candles catch when restored)

kits.grid: No grid; real-world scale, pivot at the base centre. Scale 1.

pieces.BookStand: the navigator's lectern (retint stone and brass)
pieces.Book_7: great open book on the lectern
pieces.CandleStick_Stand: tall candle stand (heavy: a few per room)
